rules.title: Basic Gameplay
rules.content: In Automatic Artistry, you will need to select suitable characters to create a lineup — then strengthen that lineup with complementary Support Cards while enhancing characters with Equipment Cards. Do your best to defeat other players' lineups and claim victory in as many matches as you can!

rules.title: Duel Phases
rules.content:
In Automatic Artistry, there are two phases — a Preparation Phase and a Battle Phase.
During the Preparation Phase, you can create a lineup by selecting rewards.
During the Battle Phase, you and your opponent will take turns to perform automatic actions. Carefully build and enhance your lineup to outperform your opponent!

rules.title: Elemental Reactions
rules.content: In Automatic Artistry, Elemental Reactions differ somewhat from their counterparts in regular Genius Invokation TCG. Elemental Mastery has also been added to the game. Raise your Elemental Mastery to increase the DMG you deal — and enhance the effects your opponent receives — when triggering Elemental Reactions

rules.title: Character Ascension
rules.content:
In Automatic Artistry, characters have both levels and ranks. You can increase your characters' levels by selecting duplicate characters from the available rewards.
Leveling up a character increases their ATK and Max HP.
When your characters reach certain levels, you can upgrade their ranks. After ranking up, characters can gain rank rewards or enhance their skills.
